items.prompt: Where apply the negative sign after parsing magnitude?

options.why: Parse the unsigned hundredths magnitude first, then negate the entire integer so both parts receive the sign.
Negating only fractional digits would turn -1.25 into positive 75 hundredths rather than -125.
Negating only the whole part would turn -1.25 into -75 hundredths rather than -125.
Dropping the sign can reverse threshold comparisons for negative correlations.

items.explanation: Sign applies to the complete magnitude.
